title: Privacy-Preserving Credit Risk Modeling with Synthetic Data
summary: A three-stage pipeline for credit risk assessment in India's digital lending market that generates synthetic credit datasets, performs unsupervised borrower risk profiling, and trains reinforcement-learning lending policies under DPDPA/RBI privacy constraints. It directly imports and runs SDV's SingleTableMetadata, CTGANSynthesizer, and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer to generate the privacy-preserving synthetic credit data that powers the whole pipeline.
